note: G2 zombie AI (game balance, not real-world data). Zombies only pursue the closest hostile and strike it in melee: no weapon, no grenades, no cover. EN1: 'types' are the enemy types on the zombie brain and pack code; [0] is the plain zombie (unchanged), AI type 'Zombies + heavies' picks a type per slot by 'weight'. Per type: model (content/characters/<model>.glb, rest pose scaled to height_m; swap it here; its bones carry the game's joint names: Hips, Spine2, Neck, Head, Left/RightArm, ForeArm, Hand, UpLeg, Leg, Foot), fallback_scale / fallback_lean_deg (used on the zombie model and clips when the model or its walk clip is missing), scale (drawn and hit at that size), lean_deg (forward tilt), tint, hp, damage per blow, reach_m (the blow lands within it), lunge_m (a strike may start this far out and closes the gap during the wind-up), cooldown_s, attack_rate (the attack clip plays at this rate; the blow lands at its swing frame, windup_s is the fallback without clips), walk_mps / run_mps (run when the target is within run_within_m), weight (share in a horde), hit_zone_scale (hit capsule radii x, on top of the body size scale x height_m / 1.85: the spider is low, so its zones are widened), knockback_mps (shove on the player), stagger_min_damage / stagger_s (only a single hit of at least this flinches it and stops it that long), clips. The zombie's run_mps sits between the jog and the sprint of content/settings/movement.json. The model is content/characters/zombie.glb (RINONO, CC-BY-4.0, docs/credits.md). models (optional): variants of the type, one per AI of it in turn (the plain zombie: zombie, zombie_necro, zombie_deadman, the last two wearing its clips retargeted by tools/bake_ai_characters.py).glb (the SCP-096 remodel, converted from the user-supplied FBX with its clips by tools/enemies/convert_enemy_glb.py; weight 0: AI type Creatures only, never in the Zombies + heavies mix; its death is a synthesized topple). Brute = content/characters/troll.glb, stalker = content/characters/spider.glb (EN1, converted from the user-supplied FBX with all clips; docs/credits.md). EN2: height_m is the rest (T-pose) height the model is scaled to: the troll's 2.78 stands about 2.4 m in its idle, the spider's 1.55 gives a back about 1.3 m high and legs about 2.3 m across / 2.6 to 3.3 m front to back. explosive_mult: every blast deals that many times its damage to the type; capsule_height_m / capsule_radius_m: its own physics capsule (the navmesh stays the soldier's). clips: damage and death take a list (one per hit / death), attack picks one at random per strike and the blow lands at that clip's swing frame; 'unused' names the takes no game state plays. EN4: climb_m: the type takes the heavies-only climb links (trench lips, crater rims, low walls up to the nav pass's heavyClimbMax_m, content/ai/navigation.json links; default 2.2 m) and, stuck for 2 s, climbs a lip up to climb_m within 3 m; step_gap_m: it also takes the heavies-only gap links (heavyGapMax_m, default 2.8 m: the spider steps over narrow trenches); clips.climb plays over a climb (none: the walk clip). CH1: sounds (optional): {attack, idle, step} audio events for a type without built-in ones. The AI types Knights, Animatronics, Aliens and Alien queens play the types knight, animatronic, alien and alien_queen, which content/ai/zombie_local.json (git-ignored) adds with their local-only models (converted by tools/enemies/convert_enemy_glb.py; the knight with tools/enemies/knight_spec.json); without it those sides are plain zombies. SND1 / SND2: sounds also takes contact (a blow lands), death and loop (a looping sound on each living one, the nearest three); any content/audio/custom/<name>.mp3 is the event <name>. SND4: windup (an event played as it commits to a blow on a human player, in place of attack, which then sounds at the blow when the wind-up lasts 1 s or more; bots get attack as before), voice_pitch (x on idle / attack / windup). The creature: creature_screech (the strongest 1.2 s of its screech) as it winds up on a player, creature_shriek on attacks on bots, the creature_ambience loop (its loud stretches joined with equal-power cross-fades). CH3 / CH4: ground_shake (0-1): each landing blow shakes the player's view, fading out by 30 m. AI types Abominations, Golems, Boglords play the local-only types abomination, golem, boglord (content/ai/zombie_local.json; without them, plain zombies). CH5: attack_dust (false: its blows throw no dust; the area, shake and sounds stay). CH7: head_mult: damage x on a head hit in place of the global head multiplier (damage.json head, 1.3); the heavies 3-4. CH6: a strike lands where the striking joint is: during a window round the clip's swing a sphere follows it (default: the clip's fastest hand) and hurts every hostile it touches once; a slam (stomp_area) lands its area where that joint meets the ground. The attack is chosen among those whose strike distance fits the target's, and the type steps (or, leap: dashes) in to it during the wind-up, facing the target until the blow. attacks (optional): [{clip, joint (a CharJoint name: RightHand, Head...), extend (m along the limb: a mace head, a jaw), radius, damage, range [min, max], leap, victims, weight, swing (fraction of the clip), window [s before, s after]}].

pack.note: PF1 hordes: with more than min_zombies alive, zombies run in packs of up to `size`. Only the leader picks a target and requests paths; followers slide along the navmesh to a wedge slot slot_spacing_m apart behind it (separation within separation_m, alignment to the leader's velocity), catch up at catch_up x speed while the leader keeps leader_pace, break off to strike any hostile within break_off_m, and path on their own beyond lost_m. A packless zombie joins the nearest pack leader within join_m.

lod.note: PF1: clips are sampled at anim_hz_near beyond anim_near_m from the camera and at anim_hz_far beyond anim_far_m; a pack follower walking beyond share_pose_m wears its leader's pose and skinned mesh.

clips.unused: Troll_Block, Troll_Block_Lower, Troll_BlockReaction, Troll_BlockReaction_Optimal, Troll_IdleToBlock (no blocking), Troll_MoveLeft/Right(Short) (no strafing), Troll_AttackBackHand/ForeHand_Enter and _Idle (wind-up and hold pieces of the _Damage swings)

Spider_Block*, Spider_BlockReaction, Spider_Block_Optimal_Reaction (no blocking), Spider_Critter_WalkBack, Spider_MoveLeft/Right(_Short) (no strafing), Spider_StunnedLoop, Spider_Attack_Leftt/Right_Enter/Loop/Exit (a held claw-attack sequence)

C.096_AChrge.F, C.096_AGate.F, C.096_AJumpFall.F, C.096_DIdle.F, C.096_Dstd.F, C.096_Dtry1.F, the other ARun / DWlk directions (no strafing); death is synthesized by tools/enemies/convert_enemy_glb.py (the model has none)
